_comment: Dated waivers for `npm run audit:gate`. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry — expired entries fail CI on purpose. Do not waive anything that ships in the deployed web app.

allow.reason: Mobile build toolchain, hoisted into the root lockfile by the mobile npm workspace. Fix is Expo SDK 53 (semver-major).
Transitive via expo; build-time only, not shipped in the web bundle.
Transitive via expo; Metro bundler, build-time only.
Transitive via expo; Metro bundler config, build-time only.
React Native bundler, build-time only. Fix is react-native 0.72+ (semver-major).
Transitive via metro (asset pipeline); build-time only, never parses user input at runtime.
Mobile runtime; fix is a semver-major RN upgrade tracked with the Expo SDK bump.
Transitive via react-native; fixed by the same RN major upgrade.
Transitive via react-native; fix requires reanimated 4 (semver-major).

Hoisted transitive (Metro chain) still pinned at 3.3.17 in the root lockfile — Dependabot PR #75 bumped the mobile workspace only, and `npm audit fix --package-lock-only` currently ERESOLVEs. Needs a deliberate root lockfile bump.
